tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a file from the workspace and returns its contents. Use after list_directory to pick a path.

path.description: Path relative to the workspace root

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel the user names.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Returns the current weather for a city. API key for the weather service is read from the server's environment.

tools.name: list_ssh_keys
tools.description: Lists the public keys in ~/.ssh so the user can choose one. Never sends private keys anywhere.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Call this tool before using the fetch tool to narrow results.
